title: hymenophyllum mikawanum
intro: Hymenophyllum mikawanum, commonly known as the Mikawa fern, is a species of fern in the family Hymenophyllaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Hymenophyllum mikawanum include acting as a wound healer and antimicrobial agent, due to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Further research is needed to confirm the specific bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions of this plant.
